title: 5SOS’s Ashton Irwin drops Manila vlog: ‘I love the Filipino people’

blocks.text: Ashton Irwin, the drummer of the Australian pop-rock band 5 Seconds of Summer (5SOS), recently shared a heartfelt tribute to his Filipino fans. In a new YouTube vlog, Irwin documented his experiences during the band’s recent stop in the country. The video captures candid backstage moments, bustling street views, and high-energy concert highlights. READ: 5 Seconds of Summer arrives in Manila “I love the Filipino people,” Irwin said in the clip. He expressed deep gratitude for the warm welcome and the unmatched passion of the local crowd.
